name_en: Sabanuta — vinegar-cured mackerel dressed with miso and mustard
summary_ja: 脂ののった若狭のサバを酢でしめて皮をむき、ねぎや辛子味噌と和える小浜の一皿。地元では「のた」「どろず」とも呼ばれ、香味野菜との組み合わせで食欲をそそる副菜として伝わる。
summary_en: Fatty Wakasa mackerel is cured in vinegar, skinned, and tossed with scallion and a mustard-miso dressing in this Obama dish, locally also called 'nota' or 'dorozu' — a piquant side meant to sharpen the appetite.
source_title: さばぬた 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Fu no karashi-ae — wheat gluten and cucumber dressed in hot mustard miso
summary_ja: もどした角麩と塩もみきゅうりを、地からしと味噌、酢で和える報恩講の精進料理。福井の地からしは油を抜かずに丸ごと粉にした独特の香りで、越前市産の赤く色づく角麩が彩りを添えると伝わる。
summary_en: Rehydrated wheat gluten and salted cucumber are dressed with local mustard, miso, and vinegar — a shojin dish for Honkoko. Fukui's mustard is milled whole without degreasing for a sharper aroma, and gluten from Echizen, tinted red in part, adds color, it is said.
source_title: 麩の辛し和え 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Furu takuan no nimono — aged, sour takuan pickle simmered fresh again
summary_ja: 翌年まで漬け込んで酸味の出た古漬けたくあんを塩抜きし、だしと醤油で煮直す福井の惣菜。地域では「よもこんじ」「大名煮」とも呼ばれ、古くなった漬物を無駄にしない知恵として各家庭に伝わる。
summary_en: Takuan pickle left to age until the next year turns sour, so it is desalted and simmered fresh in dashi and soy sauce. Known locally as 'yomokonji' or 'daimyo-ni', it is said to reflect a household habit of not letting an aging pickle go to waste.
source_title: 古たくあんの煮物 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Fukui konbumaki — dried herring rolled in kelp and simmered soft
summary_ja: 戻した身欠きニシンを昆布で巻き、箸を芯にして柔らかく煮含める正月の縁起物。北前船の寄港地・敦賀を通じて北海道の昆布とニシンが福井にもたらされたことに由来すると伝わり、盆や祝い事に大きいまま供される。
summary_en: Dried herring is rolled around a chopstick core in kelp and simmered until soft — a New Year good-luck dish said to trace back to Hokkaido kelp and herring reaching Fukui through the Kitamae-bune trade route via the port of Tsuruga. It is served whole at Obon and celebrations.
source_title: 昆布巻き／棒巻き 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Satoimo no koroni — taro simmered down until glossy and thick
summary_ja: 皮をこそげた里芋を下ゆでせずに醤油とみりんで煮つめ、とろみのある照りに仕上げる奥越の一品。豪雪と寒暖差が育てる里芋の産地として知られ、報恩講や祝いの席にふるまう精進料理と伝わる。
summary_en: Taro, its skin merely scraped rather than peeled, is simmered without pre-boiling in soy sauce and mirin until the surface turns glossy and thick — a dish from the snowy Okuetsu region known for its taro, said to be served as a shojin dish at Honkoko and celebrations.
source_title: 里芋のころ煮 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Fukui zoni — a plain miso New Year soup of round mochi and turnip
summary_ja: 板昆布のだしで丸餅とかぶを煮て味噌で味をととのえ、かつお節をのせるだけの簡素な正月の椀。具を入れない家も多く、日常の汁椀に盛るのが福井らしいとされ、嶺南では黒砂糖をのせる地域もある。
summary_en: Round mochi and turnip are simmered in a kelp broth, finished with miso and a topping of bonito flakes — a plain New Year soup often served without other fillings, in an everyday soup bowl rather than a special one. In the Reinan area some households top it with brown sugar.
source_title: 雑煮 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Seige — female snow crab simmered with grated daikon and miso
summary_ja: せいこがに（雌のズワイガニ）の足や甲羅を大根おろしと一緒に土鍋で煮て味噌を溶き、岩のりを添える南越前町河野地区の漁師料理。甲羅からよい出汁が出るとされ、ごはんにかけたり酒の肴にすると伝わる。
summary_en: The legs and shell of female snow crab are simmered in a clay pot with grated daikon, finished with miso and a scrap of rock nori — a fishermen's dish from the Kono district of Minami-Echizen. The shell is said to lend a good broth, eaten over rice or alongside sake.
source_title: せいげ 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Otsubo — sweetened azuki beans simmered with lightly salted taro
summary_ja: 砂糖でやわらかく煮た小豆に、薄い塩味の里芋を合わせる報恩講の精進料理。器の名でもある「おつぼ」に盛るのが決まりとされ、親鸞聖人が小豆を好んだという言い伝えから欠かせない一品と伝わる。
summary_en: Azuki beans simmered soft with sugar are combined with lightly salted taro — a shojin dish for Honkoko, traditionally served in the small bowl also called 'otsubo'. It is said to be indispensable owing to a tradition that the priest Shinran was fond of azuki beans.
source_title: おつぼ 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
